# Version 4.155.3 (Unreleased)
> **Security servicing and Uno compatibility**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.3 backports native security fixes and corrects Uno 6 WebAssembly linking on .NET 9 and later. The servicing update keeps the 4.155 line available to Uno Platform 6 applications without changing public APIs or bindings.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Security

- **Backported Skia security fixes** — Adds 25 CVE fixes and 13 further hardening and test fixes to the 4.155 native engine. The changes address shader-pipeline validation, GPU uploads and resource state, texture sampling, glyph bounds, and allocation arithmetic, complementing earlier security backports on this line. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5844](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5844))

## Bug Fixes

- **Uno 6 WebAssembly linking on newer .NET targets** — Uno 6.x applications using the Skia renderer no longer receive the conflicting -sUSE_WEBGPU linker option on .NET 9 and later, where Dawn supplies WebGPU. The option remains enabled for net8.0, which still uses Emscripten's built-in WebGPU port. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5835](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5835))
- **Additional native rendering hardening** — The backport also prevents unwritten scratch-texture contents from entering filtered output and corrects glyph-copy bounds. It resets Graphite depth tracking after overwriting draws to preserve painter order. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#5844](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5844))
